article.title: Holiday Kitchen Books: 5 Titles from 3000 Studios Press (2026 Guide)
article.author: Jeremy Swain
article.summary: Every holiday kitchen title from 3000 Studios Press in one place: 5 original books by Jeremy Swain, $9.99 each as EPUB and PDF.
article.leadParagraph: Looking for holiday kitchen books? 3000 Studios Press publishes 5 original holiday kitchen titles written by Jeremy Swain. Christmas cookbooks and edible gifts. This guide lists every one, explains what each shelf offers, and shows exactly where to buy them.

sections.heading: The full Holiday Kitchen shelf
body: The shelf includes “The Twelve Cookies of Christmas”, “Presents You Can Eat”, “The Slow-Cooker Christmas”, “The Make-Ahead Christmas Breakfast Book” and “A Georgia Christmas Kitchen”.

sections.heading: Price and formats
body: Every title on the shelf is $9.99. Each purchase includes both EPUB and PDF, delivered at checkout from the studio store on Payhip, so the same book works on an e-reader, a tablet, a phone or a printer.
Print editions of the wider 3000 Studios Press catalog are distributed through IngramSpark, which means bookstores and libraries can order copies through their usual channels.

sections.heading: Where to buy
body: Open the Books page at https://3000studios.vip/books and tap any cover to go straight to that title's checkout. The Holiday Kitchen filter on that page shows only this shelf.
New releases and chapter previews land first in the free 3000 Studios Substack newsletter.

sections.heading: Frequently asked questions
body: How many holiday kitchen books does 3000 Studios Press publish? 5, all listed above.
Who writes them? Every title is written by Jeremy Swain and published under the 3000 Studios Press imprint.
What do I get? A $9.99 purchase includes the EPUB and the PDF of the book.
